gen-gf-grandstander-gf-pathway-extreme: Grandstander hits the page with bold, expressive lines, all drawn thin and uniform, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Pathway Extreme is the quieter one, a modern sans with rounded letters that open up clearly and stubby ascenders.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Noto Sans Sunuwar is clean and approachable, with curves that leave daylight inside and short ascender stems on tall lowercase. Eater, the dark and aggressive heading, spaces its letters far apart, and the two make a sharp contrast.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors towers with a big x-height and diagonals as heavy as its stems, all in flat single-weight linework. And Noto Sans Sundanese keeps to a neutral, clean sans, its e crossbars open and its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Autour One is expressive and bold, drawn with one fixed nib and a minimal step from capital to lowercase. Noto Sans Tamil adds a contemporary plain sans that looks magnified, with terminals that stop well short of the stem.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-jp: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide spaces its glyphs wide with no calligraphic shading anywhere in sight. Noto Sans JP follows as a professional, modern sans with a very tall x-height, so give its size a little extra room.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-yaldevi: Metamorphous leads with large sidebearings all around, plus a high midline and a soft shift between fat and slim strokes. Yaldevi is the neutral plain sans beneath it, with an e whose eye opens to the right and outsized lowercase.
gen-gf-offside-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads as a neutral, professional plain sans, with a marker-like line and distinct open gaps in c, e, s and a. Offside sits above it, wide-tracked and commanding, with curves that refuse to close.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-sono: Sono is a professional, approachable sans with wide default spacing. Oxanium, commanding in its pen-like monoline strokes, pairs that openness with a high x-height that makes its lowercase look big and its curves end in clear daylight.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-stack-sans-headline: Stack Sans Headline is a professional, approachable plain sans with a monoline skeleton and a deep middle band between baseline and mean line. Stack Sans Headline keeps its wide gaps crisp even at tiny sizes, while Paprika scatters its letters far apart.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-stack-sans-notch: Loud, loose and wide-striding, Revalia is bold and expressive, with an open-curved lowercase g. Stack Sans Notch is a clean sans with horizontals and verticals of identical thickness, and its line glides under the eye like wire.
